tools.name: x_ads_list_ads_accounts

tools.description: List the ads accounts the authenticated user can access Native X fields and pagination are preserved; monetary fields ending in _micro are millionths of the account currency.

tools.name: x_ads_create_campaign
tools.title: x ads create campaign
tools.description: Create a campaign in an ads account. The campaign is ALWAYS created with entity_status PAUSED — it cannot serve or spend until explicitly activated with activate_campaign. Campaigns are always created with budget_optimization LINE_ITEM (the only mode ads-api still supports), so budgets are NOT set here: set daily_budget_amount_local_micro on each line item via create_line_item. Schedule (start_time/end_time) and pacing (standard_delivery) also live on line items, not campaigns, in ads-api v12. Preview by default. Ask the user to approve the exact account, target and parameters before confirm:true.
